messages:
Morgan: Hey team — hitting a weird onboarding snag with the Ruby sampleapp. After the trial token expires I get a hard failure instead of a refresh+retry. Happens on macOS with system Ruby + bundler. Repro steps below. 

Morgan: Repro:
1) bundle install
2) export REDWOOD_API_KEY=... (expired token)
3) ruby sample_app.rb

Morgan: Error log:
```
2026-03-21T14:22:01Z ERROR Redwood::Client - request failed: 401 Unauthorized
/Users/morgan/.rbenv/versions/3.0.2/lib/ruby/gems/3.0.0/gems/redwood-ruby-0.9.1/lib/redwood/client.rb:142:in `request'

Faraday::UnauthorizedError (401)
```

Morgan: I expect the SDK to attempt token refresh (we have a refresh hook registered in sampleapp) and retry once, but it bails. Also noticed bundler pulled faraday 2.7.2 here — maybe an interaction. Anyone seen this? @Sam?

Sam: Hmm, not seen that exact combo. Two quick asks: can you paste your Gemfile and the snippet where you register the refresh hook? Also which version of redwood-ruby is this (0.9.1 per stack) — we landed a retry-fix in main recently.

Morgan: Gemfile snippet:
```
source 'https://rubygems.org'
gem 'redwood', '~> 0.9.1'
# no explicit faraday pin here
```

Morgan: Refresh hook in sample_app.rb:
```ruby
client = Redwood::Client.new(api_key: ENV['REDWOOD_API_KEY'], refresh_token: -> { fetch_fresh_token_from_file })
```

Alex: FYI I opened a PR about slightly different failure handling: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-ruby/pull/847 — that one ensures 401 triggers the refresh callback then retry. But it assumed Faraday::RequestFailed vs Faraday::UnauthorizedError differences across faraday versions. Could be a compatibility gap if bundler uses 2.7.

Priya: We had a test matrix gap for faraday 2.7 in CI. Short term mitigation: pin Faraday >= 2.8 in Gemfile or add an explicit dependency in the gemspec. Longer term we should normalize on handling both error classes. Proposed minimal change: in the client retry wrapper, catch both Faraday::UnauthorizedError and Faraday::ClientError subclasses and call refresh_callback then retry once. 

Priya: Pseudopatch:
```ruby
begin
  resp = inner_request.call
rescue Faraday::UnauthorizedError, Faraday::ClientError => e
  if e.status == 401 && refresh_callback
    refresh_callback.call
    retry
  else
    raise
  end
end
```

Sam: That looks reasonable. Can we add a unit test that simulates old faraday raising different exception class to avoid regressions? Also add changelog note.

Morgan: I can prepare a small PR tonight with the catch + test + changelog. Quick question: do we want to pin faraday in the SDK gemspec or just update sampleapp docs to pin for onboarding?

Alex: Prefer not to pin in gemspec unless absolutely necessary. Docs + CI matrix are better. We'll push a patch to be compatibility-agnostic.

CI-bot: CI: redwood-ruby #847 — tests failing on ruby 2.7 matrix (flaky), see https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/4521

Priya: Thanks. Morgan — if you can include a sampleapp patch to the quickstart README showing `gem 'faraday', '>= 2.8'` that should alleviate most onboarding problems while we fix the client.

Morgan: Will do. Opening draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/samples/pull/129 — includes sampleapp README change and the unit test repro.

Sam: Nice. Ping me on the PR when ready, I can help with the test harness. :thumbsup:

Morgan: Thanks all — this one feels low friction to fix. I'll merge the docs patch first then follow up with SDK change.
